payload.title: Priming provider budget always denies: tiktoken cannot map pinned model gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17
payload.description: priming_provider_budget.validate calls tiktoken.encoding_for_model(MODEL); tiktoken 0.12.0 raises KeyError for gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17, which is turned into BudgetDenied 'pinned model tokenizer is unavailable', so every provider request is denied. Found by PPY-c4e950 when CI began running pytest-style modules (10 failures in test_priming_provider_budget.py; they never ran under unittest). Fix: pick the encoding explicitly (get_encoding) or upgrade tiktoken, then remove the ignore in tests.yml.
